item.title: ACNA panel recommends archbishop stand trial
item.description: The Board of Inquiry issued a short statement on Friday stating that there was “probable cause to present” ACNA Archbishop Steve Wood “for trial for violation of Canon 2 of this Title.”

item.title: Almost half of UK adults plan to attend church this Christmas, new poll finds
item.description: Churches across the UK are expecting fuller pews this Christmas, as new research suggests a significant rise in the number of people planning to attend services and church-run events over the festive season.
